stem: Why did the United States decide to enter World War I?

options.label: F
options.text: The United States had suffered economically from European sanctions.

options.label: G
options.text: A European nation had taken aggressive actions against the United States.

options.label: H
options.text: The U.S. president was obligated to fulfill election campaign promises.

options.label: J
options.text: Communist activities among U.S. immigrants were threatening the country.
